definition.name: Warm / cool tape
definition.description: Two independently switched LED channels share one positive pad.

terminals.label: W
terminals.purpose: Warm / single-channel switched negative connection. Channel power depends on its conducting time.

terminals.label: C
terminals.purpose: Cool channel switched negative connection. Channel power depends on its conducting time.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Light source
parts.purpose: The bulb, LED module or emergency-light emitter converts electrical power into illumination. Visible brightness follows the actual emitting-load power relative to its rating. The display is an illustrative brightness scale; heat, measured optical output and colour rendering are outside the electrical model.

parts.name: Electronic control board
parts.purpose: This conceptual board represents an electronic interface. The model follows stated input, output and power limits rather than reconstructing proprietary firmware.

definition.abstraction: The resistive operating-point model estimates channel power and relative brightness. It does not predict colour temperature or photometry.

terminals.label: W
terminals.purpose: Warm / single-channel switched negative connection. Channel power depends on its conducting time.

terminals.label: C
terminals.purpose: Cool channel switched negative connection. Channel power depends on its conducting time.

data.detailPurpose: Copper pads and continuous foil tracks carry the supply along the flexible base. Each repeating section ends at the printed cut mark.
Each surface-mounted LED emits through a phosphor window. Separate warm and cool packages on a tunable strip use separate return paths.
